android_mechanism: String assembled inefficiently (concatenation) for display; fix builds it efficiently/only what is needed
bug_description: The shared HTTP client logs every successful API response with JSON.stringify(res.result).substring(0, 200): the ENTIRE response object (large question lists, article payloads) is serialized into a string only to keep the first 200 characters. Every API call pays a full-payload serialization plus a substring copy on its completion path.
fix_summary: The log records only the response code and message fields, removing the full-body JSON.stringify and truncation copy.
trigger_steps: Launch the app and browse the home question list (multiple API calls with large list payloads).
Scroll through several list pages, triggering 10+ API responses.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: CPU time spent in the HTTP response handling path per API call (between response receipt and promise resolution visible in JS sampling), averaged over >= 10 calls.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed serializes each full response body (O(payload)); fixed logs O(1) fields. With list payloads of tens of KB, unfixed per-response overhead > fixed.
